I answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

Both sources are things Marcus can see himself. Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the door 6 duplicate arrivals on the morning shift. The public North team cheat sheet also lists Thea as QFL's main contact.

I didn't use gbrain this time, since it refused the last search because its token isn't tied to any member.
